name: llm-perf-dashboard
description: An aggregated performance dashboard/dataset that collects and displays large language model evaluations across many tasks and metrics, enabling side-by-side comparison of model capabilities. It covers a variety of evaluation types (QA, reasoning, code generation, multiple-choice) and reports standardized metrics to track LLM performance trends.
evaluation_method: composite_score (aggregated metrics such as accuracy, exact_match, F1 depending on task)
reputation: Maintained within the Hugging Face/Optimum ecosystem and moderately used for model benchmarking and monitoring in that community.
